title: NeuralOS knowledge graph node
description: One resource in the knowledge graph (DESIGN.md section 3.4). The runtime stores relations as edges with a kind (src/kernel/types.ts EDGE_KINDS).

id.description: Unique node id, for example node_551.

type.description: Resource kind. The first nine come from DESIGN.md section 3.4; project and workflow from the canvas node types in section 4; workspace, memory, concept and output are used by the runtime (src/kernel/types.ts NODE_TYPES).

name.description: Human-readable name, for example Code Reviewer.

relations.description: Edges to other nodes. Each item is a node id string or an object naming the target and the kind of link.
